decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate is 0.011188 against row_count 45228, so roughly 506 rows are full-row exact duplicates in bronze and must be collapsed to one row per unique business key set before silver load.

invoice (distinct_count 2330) paired with stockcode (distinct_count 3141) identifies one product line per invoice; invoicedate is uniform per invoice in the samples, so (invoice, stockcode) is the smallest defensible grain after exact-duplicate removal.
null_rate 0.29778 (13468 of 45228) is too high to treat as an anomaly; nulls are retained rather than imputed, representing unidentified or guest customers.
null_rate 0.005041 (228 of 45228) is low but nonzero; description is informational text so nulls are retained without failing the build.

_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are all flagged is_airbyte_metadata true and carry only capture-tool bookkeeping (UUIDs, load timestamps, an empty JSON object), so all three are dropped.
All ten sampled quantity values are integral (e.g. -1395.0, -1043.0) despite the landed DECIMAL(38,9) type, and the full range (-1395.0 to 5184.0) fits INTEGER cleanly.
Sampled price values show at most two decimal places (0.04 through 0.18) with max 1998.49, so DECIMAL(10,2) is sufficient precision for a monetary column.
All sampled invoicedate values are ISO-shaped datetime strings (e.g. 2009-12-01 07:45:00) with null_rate 0.0, supporting a strict cast to TIMESTAMP.

Negative quantity samples (min -1395.0, multiple negative values in the top-10 sample) indicate return or cancellation lines, so is_return_flag is derived from quantity < 0 to let consumers separate returns from gross sales.

purpose: silver_online_retail_ii cleans the bronze online_retail_ii capture into analysis-ready invoice line items, suitable for revenue, returns, and customer analytics feeding downstream retail reporting marts.
usage: Consumers should treat (invoice, stockcode) as the row grain after exact-duplicate removal, filter on is_return_flag = true when return or cancellation lines must be excluded from gross sales totals, and handle customer_id nulls (about 30% of rows) as unidentified-customer transactions rather than data errors.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188 of 45228 rows) are removed during cleanup but no clock-drift correction is applied since _airbyte_extracted_at shows only a one-second capture window; description (null_rate 0.005041) and customer_id (null_rate 0.29778) remain nullable because cleanup does not impute missing values; invoice and stockcode remain VARCHAR since alphanumeric codes in the samples prevent numeric casting.
